title: Notion MCP notion-ai-search is missing from tools/list and connector search needs notion-connector-search
symptoms: notion-ai-search no longer appears in the client tool list
Cannot find notion-connector-search in the tool list after reconnecting
Search returns only Notion pages and databases, no Slack or Drive hits
cause: From October 20, 2026, hosted Notion MCP notion-search searches only Notion pages and databases. Connected sources moved to the new notion-connector-search tool, which is listed only when the user has AI search and the workspace has a connected source. notion-ai-search is hidden from tools/list but still callable by name. Workspace-owned connections keep their selected tools. In ChatGPT the new tool appears only after OpenAI reviews the updated Notion app.
fix: Refresh the client's tool list or reconnect Notion MCP, then call notion-connector-search for Slack, Drive, GitHub, mail and calendar, optionally passing sources to narrow it. Use notion-fetch with a result id or url to open a connector result (Outlook, Google Calendar and Confluence results cannot be fetched).
